strongest_angle: OpenAI and ServiceNow announced an expanded partnership on October 28, 2026, integrating OpenAI models and agents into ServiceNow products to automate development, security, and employee workflows.

key_facts.fact: On October 28, 2026, OpenAI and ServiceNow announced an expanded partnership to bring OpenAI models and agents into ServiceNow workflows ranging from development to security.
ServiceNow, traded on the NYSE under the ticker NOW and headquartered in Santa Clara, California, announced the expanded collaboration on October 28, 2026.
According to AI Affairs, the October 28, 2026 agreement expanded upon a previous January 2026 partnership between OpenAI and ServiceNow.
